gates.requiredScope: The eligible intake, current Ready series review, feature identity, branch, accepted hashes, run state and current MergeAndSync authority remain aligned.
gates.rationale: The sandbox decision requires immutable intake lineage and current explicit authority.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any intake, review, series, branch, authority, task or state drift.

gates.requiredScope: Exactly twelve CL-12 controls, seven mount roles and eight execution decisions validate against the accepted sandbox commit and source hashes.
gates.rationale: Cardinality, provenance and wrapper parity are the primary feature acceptance contract.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any assessment row, validator, wrapper, sandbox pin or source hash changes.

gates.requiredScope: Learner-facing security guidance is German-first and English-second at CEFR-B2, semantically structured, UTF-8 clean and usable through text-first assistive tools.
gates.rationale: The feature creates and publishes learner-facing security documentation.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any documentation, navigation, language or accessibility change.

gates.requiredScope: Bash, PowerShell and Python syntax, static analysis, help, manual and cross-platform wrapper behavior remain equivalent.
gates.rationale: A new portable read-only validator family is delivered.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any script, help, manual, shell or supported platform changes.

gates.requiredScope: Repository diff, formatting, statistics, agent parity, secrets, dependencies and supply-chain checks pass without product or generated-output drift.
gates.rationale: Documentation and validator changes still require repository integrity and secure-development evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any source, test, dependency, generated output, statistics, agent surface or delivery-set change.

gates.requiredScope: Product build, runtime tests and five-assembly coverage.
gates.rationale: The final delivery set changes no product source, API, project, package, example or executable behavior; remote baseline CI remains supplemental.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Executable product scope enters the delivery set.

gates.requiredScope: The exact reviewed feature head is pushed, all mandatory GitHub technical checks pass, no actionable review thread remains and provider-neutral PreMerge evidence validates.
gates.rationale: Remote delivery requires exact-head technical and review convergence before any bypass decision.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any head, workflow, check, review thread, comment or authority change.

gates.requiredScope: Only after every technical gate passes, the authorized admin bypass may cover the sole remaining approval rule; merge commit, branch cleanup, main synchronization and causal PostMerge evidence complete the run.
gates.rationale: The latest user instruction explicitly grants MergeAndSync and a narrow approval-only bypass.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any failing technical gate, actionable review, merge failure, cleanup failure or default-branch drift.
